writeup: Woot has a new Kensington Pro Fit Ergo KB680 EQ rechargeable wireless keyboard for $14.99. This is the split-layout ergonomic model with a built-in wrist rest plus Bluetooth and 2.4GHz connectivity, matching MPN K72485NA and UPC 085896724858. DataBit lists the same new black keyboard in stock for $41.00, and DirectDial has the matching MPN at $47. That is about 63 percent below DataBit and saves about $26. Woot showed 1+ left with a limit of one per customer.
